pages.title: Scout
pages.text: $(bold)Maps, the compass and the cartography table, and the waystones on the Monoliths: wake them and travel between those you have woken. Making, placing and breaking waystones wait for Attunement. Taking Scout closes Hunter. +2% movement speed.$(br2)$(thing)Copper Age$(n), ring 2.$(br)$(thing)8 Focal Shards$(n).$(br)After Ranger.

pages.title: Task
pages.text: $(bold)$(thing)Walk 6,000 blocks$(n)$(br2)Pays 1 Focal Shard once. Counts only once this node is reachable.
